headline: CBK Governor Backs Plan to Centralise Kenyan County Accounts
summary: Central Bank of Kenya Governor Kamau Thugge supported proposed amendments to the Public Finance Management Act requiring county governments to secure National Treasury approval for bank accounts.
why: Centralising devolved government cash balances allows Kenya's Treasury to manage liquidity, cut commercial bank borrowing, and control debt servicing costs.

impacts.name: Kenyan Commercial Banking
impacts.why: Sweeping county deposits out of commercial banks may reduce low-cost institutional deposit bases.
